description: Lists the items of ONE screen of a WinCC Unified HMI as {hmi, screen, screenNumber, width, height, items:[{name, type, visible, enabled, left, top, width, height}], total, nextCursor, inventoryGaps}; type is the item class (HmiButton, HmiIOField, ...) and the layout values are null for a type that does not offer them. Items are flat: the V21 API exposes no nested items. Use it to inspect a screen (screen names come from tia_hmi_screens); an unknown screen is 404 not_found. For a large HMI read it in pages: pass limit (1-1000), then pass the nextCursor of each page as cursor until nextCursor is null; total is the number of items of the whole list. Without limit and cursor the whole list is returned with nextCursor null. A cursor of a list that changed is 409 cursor_stale (restart without cursor), one that is not a nextCursor is 400 invalid_cursor. `inventoryGaps` [{kind, subject, reason}] lists every value or object the serve could not read while building the answer (empty when all reads succeeded): the unreadable value is null and one gap names it, so a null next to a gap means unreadable, while a value the object does not offer is null without a gap. Needs an open project and a WinCC Unified HMI (hmi = its name from tia_hmis, matched ignoring case): a classic WinCC HMI is refused with 409 hmi_not_unified, an unknown HMI is 404 not_found and two HMIs with the same name are 409 ambiguous_name. Maps to GET /hmi/{hmi}/screens/{screen}/items?limit=&cursor= (both optional). Read-only (class R).

cursor.description: the nextCursor of the previous page, passed back exactly as received; it is opaque, so never invent, build or edit one (omit it for the first page, and omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)

hmi.description: HMI name, as listed by tia_hmis (a WinCC Unified HMI)

limit.description: page size, an integer from 1 to 1000; pass it to read the list in pages (omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)

screen.description: screen name, as listed by tia_hmi_screens

name: tia_hmi_screen_items
title: TIA — HMI Unified screen items
